title: Chapter 403
paragraphs: Chapter 403
Episode 119. The Banquet at Sword Emperor Castle (8)
Very few people knew what the gray robes symbolized. The Phantom Group was not a revealed force in the world, unlike Runcandel's Black Knights.
They stood among the monsters, watching the crumbling Sword Emperor Castle.
It seemed as if they had been waiting for the central arena's wall to collapse.
Slowly, they approached the central arena.
'Were they waiting near Sword Emperor Castle and revealed themselves to escort Veradin?'
It was possible.
However, Jin felt a strange sense of discomfort from the gray-robed individuals. Somehow, it seemed like they were controlling the monsters and biological golems.
It wasn't just a feeling of incongruity that he could immediately recognize.
The biological golems were clearing a path in the direction they were walking.
Ron had an indifferent look in his eyes. It was not due to leisure but the composure unique to a martial artist who had reached the extreme.
Ooong-!
A red-colored magic power was forming on the gray-robed people's staffs.
And that magic was something Jin had experienced firsthand at Veradin's villa, towards the end of his preparatory training period.
-"Even the losers of the Inse Competition are spreading the Red Abyss just to catch one child. The old Phantom Group would have nothing to say even if they came out of their graves."
At that time, Misha had informed him that the name of the magic was Red Abyss.

Giant red stains began to spread all over the sky soaked in the veil of energy. The large-scale circular magic of the Phantom Group, which could be called their decisive weapon, Red Abyss, had struggled with the black dragons' energy at that time.
That day was one of the most dangerous moments in Jin's life.
That's why everything was vividly recalled. The bloody swords and chains pouring down from the red-stained sky, and the sensation of his palms tearing as he blocked them.
And there was one more thing, an impression Jin clearly remembered.
-'There are awkward elements in the process of complementing each other's magic power.'
It was an impression he felt while reading the flow of the Red Abyss spread by the fifteen Phantom Group members.
Based on that fact, Jin intuitively felt that the Red Abyss required more people.
'But their magic power is too clean now.'
There were a total of six gray-robed people who came to Sword Emperor Castle.
The magic that even fifteen people awkwardly unfolded due to insufficient magic power was being perfectly cast by six people.
It was an impossibility with the magical knowledge Jin knew.
At first, he thought the magic the gray-robed people were using was the Phantom Group's Red Abyss since he had only seen it once and could not access it through books.
Upon closer inspection, it was similar but clearly a different magic.
"It's not the Phantom Group. They are six highly skilled individuals who can imitate the Phantom Group and their secret magic."
Jin was the only one who saw through this fact clearly.
From the beginning, there were only a few people among the martial artists present who knew about the existence of the Phantom Group, and they had never experienced the Red Abyss firsthand.
It was possible for Gipfel to attack Hairan, but using the combination of the Phantom Group and monsters was an impossible scenario.
It would be crazy to add monsters to the already tarnished image of the Holy Kingdom after the incident.
"So it's not Gipfel. It's either Kinzelo or Bimonte, and the former has more reasons to target Hairan. It's strange to think that the emperor would stage such an event to check Ron's power."
Kinzelo.
Jin's irritation grew as he wondered what they were up to this time.
There must be a reason they deliberately disguised themselves as Gipfel's secret mage squad with a clumsy atmosphere.
Gooooo…!
The atmosphere was vibrating due to the gray-robed people's circular magic. From the red-stained areas in the sky, red swords and chains made of magic power poured down.
It wasn't as powerful as the real Phantom Group's Red Abyss. However, as a circular magic by mages of comparable skill, it possessed a terrifying destructive power.
Murakan and the dragons couldn't block everything. They didn't have much energy left as they had to counter the huge monsters firing at them from the ground.
"I'm not comfortable using Bimonte's power, but I have no choice."
In the end, Quicantel decided to transform into her true form and use her time power.
"Enya, you spread the Dragon Fire Barrier. Don't stray too far from me."
"Yes…!"
Quicantel shot her power towards the sky without flying. Silver waves extending from her forehead intertwined with the circular magic.
The situation on the ground seemed to improve as the Time Power and Dragon Fire Barrier unfolded.
However, the death toll continued to rise. Some martial artists suffered fatal injuries or died instantly.
"Ahhh!"
A woman was thrown to the ground, letting out a painful scream.
"Marjiela!"
Bischel shouted with a blood-spitting voice.
She had been wrapped up in the fragments of the circular magic, her wheelchair completely shattered, rolling on the ground.
Bischel had been cutting down anything approaching his sister since before. Monster flesh and bones, magic missiles, and circular magic, as well as other people.
Bischel didn't cut everyone, but those who recklessly jumped in and posed a threat to Marjiela were not spared.
Bubar was already severely injured and barely managed to support himself behind Bischel.
While cutting monsters in a frenzy, Jin happened to catch sight of their situation.
Rather, the fact that Marjiella was in a precarious state confirmed the suspicion.
However, as if it didn't matter if they were caught, from the beginning, it seemed certain that Jin would figure out the culprit at this point.
As soon as Jin's eyes met Marjiella's, she mouthed the following words.
You will gain great benefits, Jin.
It was clearly readable.
The reason Marjiella came out so confidently was that Kinzelo had already achieved their goal.
'...So, it didn't matter to Kinzelo whether the mages impersonating the Ghost Squad were revealed to be not from Zipple.'
Jin thought so and looked around.
Although it was disgusting enough to make his hair stand on end, it was not a situation where he could go over and confront them right away.
The number of giant demons gushing from underground did not seem to decrease.
Kuuuuk-!

Eventually, the ominous sound of the ground collapsing, followed by the sight of the earth sinking in all directions, continued. As dark pits formed, people fell into them, leaving long screams and disappearing.
Still, the desperate efforts of the knights and warriors of Sword Emperor Castle were not in vain.
Already, more than half of those who were in the central arena had escaped to the inner castle.
However, as the demons outside continued to attack the outer castle, there was no guarantee of safety unless they were eradicated.
Who would think that this attack was carried out by Kinzelo?
There is little evidence to prove it, and even if they captured and tortured Bisuchel's group, they wouldn't be able to get a confession.
Of course, Hairan, who has Ron as a pillar, will clearly face their enemies.
However, the situation was different for other small and medium-sized families who were affected by this attack.
Among the victims, rumors circulated that Hairan used Kinzelo to cover up the fact that they were attacked by Zipple.
Ron's fear would keep them quiet, but Hairan's reputation would not be the same as before.
Of course, Zipple would reach out to help Hairan in trouble.
Or, the moment Sword Emperor Castle requested an explanation, they could bite Hairan, claiming that they were being used after being attacked by another power.
Either way, it was a huge loss for Hairan.
'Ron will reject whatever deal Zipple proposes, and this incident will end with Hairan looking like a fool.'
That was Jin's calculation.
So, what did Kinzelo want to gain in this process?
'The hostile relationship between Hairan and Zipple. They want other major powers to more actively keep Zipple in check.'
It could be a leap.
However, Jin concluded that it was an issue that could be perfectly assured as long as he didn't miss the 'last piece' of this incident.
'I need to tell Ron what that is!'
The gray-robed figures were gathering their circle magic. However, this was not a retreat, but a preparation for a new attack.
Then, a flash of light shot towards the gray-robed figures.
The flash pierced through four giant monsters, swept away hundreds of biological golems, and tore through layers of protective shields, eventually piercing the chest of one gray-robed figure.
The gray-robed figures, now reduced to five, scattered and reorganized their defenses.
"Did you think that putting on those gray robes would fool me? You claim to be underlings of Octavia Zipple."
Ron had already defeated over a hundred giant monsters and thousands of biological golems, but his energy only grew stronger.
To Ron, the number of monsters or golems was meaningless. No matter how many sparks there were, they were insignificant in front of a storm.
The only reason he could not end the situation was that the 'culprits' who came to and were protecting Gyeomhwang Castle had hostages.
He felt a boiling rage within him, even more so than when he admitted defeat in the competition with Chiron.
"Ron Hairan, you misunderstand. Deceiving you was never part of our plan."
"I'll find out what that plan is by tearing your mouths apart. So, have you shown me everything you can?"
The gray-robed figures did not answer.
They were preparing to destroy the last piece of the puzzle that Jin had thought of.
"Lord Ron!"
Ron turned his eyes to Jin.
"There's something more important than killing them. We must find Veradin!"
"What...?"
"If Veradin returns to his family injured, it will be difficult to handle Kinzelo's scheme. Hairan will become a clear enemy to Zipple!"
At those words, Ron's eyes widened.
All the possibilities Jin had considered a moment ago flashed through Ron's mind in an instant, exactly the same way.
Jin was right.
If Veradin could not return safely, Hairan and Zipple would inevitably become enemies, regardless of how the situation unfolded.
Even if Kinzelo consistently denied it, even if the victims doubted Hairan, even if Zipple used all of this to pressure Hairan.
If Veradin could be safely returned to his family without a scratch, they could properly deal with all these cases.
Jin felt as if he could see the startled faces of the gray-robed figures, even though they were hidden under hoods. He could also see the distorted faces of the injured-looking Bishkel and his group.
"There must be more magicians of that level, and they are likely pursuing Veradin!"
Ron's eyes widened.
"Can I trust you with this, Jin Runcandel?"
He had a duty to save the dying relatives and guests in front of him.
"Of course, Lord Ron. I will gladly accept the responsibility."
